title: Build an Accessible Tab Component
description: Create a set of tabs with proper ARIA, keyboard navigation, and panel display.
problemStatement:
## Accessible Tabs

Build an HTML/CSS/JS tab component with three tabs: "Details", "Shipping", "Reviews". Requirements:

* Use semantic buttons for tabs, wrapped in a container with `role="tablist"`.
* Each tab has `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-controls`.
* Panels have `role="tabpanel"` and `aria-labelledby`.
* Only the active panel is visible; others are hidden using the `hidden` attribute.
* Keyboard: Left/Right arrows switch tabs (roving tabindex), Tab moves into the active panel.
* Clicking a tab activates it.
* Initial active tab is the first one.

Write the complete HTML, CSS (minimal for visibility), and JavaScript.
hints: Use `tabindex="0"` on the active tab and `tabindex="-1"` on others.
Add a `keydown` event listener for ArrowLeft and ArrowRight.
expectedOutput: A working tab component that passes axe DevTools checks and is keyboard navigable.
